import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Corresponding target column names for SalePrice from each source
    # According to target schema:
    # 'SalePrice_x' from Source9_14_0
    # 'SalePrice_y' from Source9_14_1
    # 'SalePrice_x_3' from Source9_14_2
    # 'SalePrice_y_4' from Source9_14_3
    # 'SalePrice_x_5' from Source9_14_4
    # 'SalePrice_y_6' from Source9_14_5
    # 'SalePrice_x_7' from Source9_14_6
    # 'SalePrice_y_8' from Source9_14_7
    # 'SalePrice_x_9' from Source9_14_8
    # 'SalePrice_y_10' from Source9_14_9
    target_columns = [
        "SalePrice_x",
        "SalePrice_y",
        "SalePrice_x_3",
        "SalePrice_y_4",
        "SalePrice_x_5",
        "SalePrice_y_6",
        "SalePrice_x_7",
        "SalePrice_y_8",
        "SalePrice_x_9",
        "SalePrice_y_10"
    ]

    # Load all sources into dataframes with renamed SalePrice columns
    dfs = []
    for file_path, col_name in zip(source_files, target_columns):
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, usecols=["Id", "SalePrice"])
        df = df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": col_name})
        dfs.append(df)

    # Merge all dataframes on 'Id' using inner join to keep only common Ids
    # Start with the first dataframe
    merged_df = dfs[0]
    for df in dfs[1:]:
        merged_df = pd.merge(merged_df, df, on="Id", how="inner")

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    merged_df["Id"] = merged_df["Id"].astype(int)
    for col in target_columns:
        merged_df[col] = merged_df[col].astype(float)

    # Save the result to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    merged_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
